cards.text: Pilate has granted the crowd's demand that Jesus be crucified. As the soldiers lead Him away, they seize a man named Simon of Cyrene, who's on his way in from the country. One minute he's walking into town minding his business, and the next minute soldiers have him by the arm.

cards.question: The soldiers grab Simon of Cyrene off the road. What do they make him do?

answers.text: Lead the way to the city gate
Hold back the crowd on the road

cards.text: Simon's not the only one following. A great number of people follow Jesus, including women who keep mourning and wailing for Him.

cards.question: Jesus turns to the women weeping for Him and tells them not to weep for Him. Who does He tell them to weep for instead?

cards.text: He calls them daughters of Jerusalem. He warns that days are coming when people will call the women who never had children blessed, and they'll say to the mountains, "Fall on us!"
Then He leaves them with one more line: "For if men do these things while the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?" Friend, that's a line you chew on for a long time.

cards.question: Jesus isn't the only one led away to be executed. The two others led away with Him are two of His disciples.

cards.text: Then they come to the place called The Skull, and they crucify Him there. Friend, I've told a lot of stories in my bakery, and this is the hardest one to tell.

cards.question: The two criminals are crucified at The Skull along with Jesus. Where are they placed?

answers.text: One on His right and one on His left
Both of them down the hill behind Him
Both of them together on His right

cards.question: Hanging on the cross, Jesus speaks to His Father. What does He ask?

answers.text: Forgive them because they don't know what they're doing
Judge them for everything they have done to Me
Take Me down from this cross before the night

cards.question: Right there below Jesus, they divide up His ___ by casting lots.

cards.text: The people stand there watching. The rulers sneer at Him: "He saved others; let Him save Himself if He is the Christ of God, the Chosen One."
And it's not just the rulers. The soldiers mock Him too, and they come up and offer Him sour wine.

cards.question: The soldiers' taunt sounds a lot like the rulers' sneer. What do the soldiers say to Jesus?

answers.text: If You are the King of the Jews save Yourself
If You are a prophet tell us who hit You
If You are the Son of God call down fire

cards.question: The inscription posted above Jesus on the cross calls Him the King of the Jews.

cards.text: Jesus is on the cross, with a criminal hanging on each side. One of them heaps abuse on Him. "Are You not the Christ?" he says. "Save Yourself and us!"

cards.question: The other criminal hanging beside Jesus joins right in and mocks Him too.
The second criminal rebukes the first one. What does he say about the punishment the two of them are getting?

answers.text: It is just for what they did
It is far too harsh for them
It is a mistake by the soldiers

cards.question: Then the second criminal says Jesus has done nothing ___.

cards.text: Then he turns to Jesus: "Jesus, remember me when You come into Your kingdom!" Friend, the man is hanging on a cross, and he's asking about a KINGDOM.

cards.question: The criminal asks Jesus to remember him. What does Jesus promise him?

answers.text: Today you will be with Me in Paradise
Someday you will see My kingdom come
Tonight you will be taken down and freed

cards.text: It's now about the sixth hour, and darkness comes over all the land until the ninth hour. The sun is darkened, and friend, I spent years in the dark of a junk drawer, but this is a whole different kind of dark.

cards.question: The sun is darkened, and something happens at the temple as well. What happens to the temple's veil?

answers.text: It is torn down the middle
It is rolled up and hidden

cards.question: Then Jesus calls out to His Father in a loud voice. What does He say?

answers.text: Into Your hands I commit My Spirit
Send Your angels to take Me down
Let this darkness end right now

cards.text: And when He had said this, He breathed His last. Friend, let that one sit for a second.

cards.question: A centurion, a Roman army officer, sees what happened. He gives glory to God.
The centurion says Jesus was surely a ___ man.

cards.text: A whole crowd gathered to watch this spectacle. Now they've seen what happened, and friend, there's no unseeing it.

cards.question: The crowd that gathered for the spectacle heads home. How do they go?
Everyone who knew Jesus, including the women who followed Him from Galilee, stands right beside the cross.

cards.text: All those who knew Jesus, including the women who followed Him from Galilee, stand at a distance watching these things. Keep that apron on, friend, because this story is NOT done.

findings.problem: The earlier cards give no way to reason out that the object is garments. Nothing has mentioned Jesus' belongings or anything being divided, and the setup does not distinguish garments from money or scrolls, so the baker is guessing an unseen detail.

rule.text: The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

findings.problem: The opening sentence retells the arrangement of one criminal on each side of Jesus, which comes from Luke 23:33, but the card cites only Luke 23:39.

rule.text: Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.

findings.problem: This is not the walkthrough's opening card, and it runs to four sentences: two setup sentences followed by the two quoted sentences. That exceeds the story-card limit.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.
